defect.reproducer: In a temporary bridge copy set IMU direction ROS_TO_GZ (or wrong gz topic). ros2 topic info -v /vehicle/imu still showed a ROS publisher from the bridge, but ros2 topic echo /vehicle/imu --once timed out while gz topic -e -t /vehicle/imu had data.
defect.root_cause: Bridge direction/topic mismatch: GZ_TO_ROS required for IMU. Wrong direction leaves an empty ROS publisher without carrying Gazebo samples.
defect.proof_after: Restored direction GZ_TO_ROS and qos_profile SENSOR_DATA in config/bridge.yaml. Echo and bag show /vehicle/imu messages; info -v reports BEST_EFFORT keep_last(5).
